### Operative observation (v18)

v17 framed the 9th-consecutive AP13-05 fire as "the orchestrator's dispatch routing is structurally biased toward feature epics regardless of what its own retrospectives codify." The 12th fire confirms this without ambiguity. **v18 adds a new structural observation: the orchestrator's status-transition routing is biased toward `dev-pass-completes-→-set-done` rather than `code-review-Approve-verdict-→-set-done`.** The 72h window contains three independent instances of this pattern (17-0, 17-1, 17-2), each with the same inline-note shape ("awaiting bmad-code-review pass N"). This is not three discoveries of the same anti-pattern; it is one anti-pattern fired three times by a structurally biased dispatcher.

The single CRITICAL/HIGH item that maps cleanly to a single skill dispatch is 17-3 code-review pass-3 (HIGH). The CRITICAL retroactive-closure work (re-pass for 17-0/17-1/17-2) requires three additional dispatches and should be sequenced after 17-3 ships to avoid context contention on the reviewer.
